scope: percentage-only cross-game ML, ATS and mixed parlays, no dollar allocation
policy_notes: Every game audits home/away ML and home/away spread, but combination search chooses the model favorite ML and highest-EV ATS side per game.
Spread pushes void that leg in a parlay and are included in gross-return probability.
Two or more legs must reference different games, regardless of market kind.
No bankroll, stake size, arbitrary fixed number of tickets or forced parlay.
Current 2026 replay is restricted to completed games; upcoming Sunday requires contemporaneous single-book h2h+spread prices.
All historical moneylines and spread lines are price proxies unless independently timestamp-verified.
